scenario: LGRA.8.6's load-bearing exemption — *"A reference in the pattern's own `where` counts"*. Pin: `Graph g where g.root == "/src"` compiles. This is the case the work order singles out as the one that would demand the impossible if it regressed: a single-pattern filter rule references its binding only from its own where-clause, so a rule that counted only LATER references would reject the commonest shape in the language. Paired with LGRA.8.6_unreferenced_binding — that one shows the check fires, this one shows it discriminates, and a check that only ever fires is [STYL.5.10.5]'s failure in the other direction.
rules_ds:
schema Graph scope logical:
    root: String key

rule r:
    Graph g where g.root == "/src"
->
    log info "x"
